q: We define focal length, $f$ of a lens as the image distance when the object is at _____.
e: Focal length is the image distance for an object at infinity. Do not swap object and image here. We define focal length, f of a lens as the image distance when the object is at infinity. Do not trade infinity for focus or centre.

q: The object distance $u$ and the image distance $v$ are measured from the _____ of the lens $P$.
e: Lenses refract. Light is an electromagnetic wave and also a particle. The object distance u and the image distance v are measured from the centre of the lens P. Do not trade centre for focus or edge.

q: According to the sign convention for lenses, distances of real object, real image and real focus are _____.
e: A real image can be put on a screen. A virtual image cannot; the rays only appear to meet. According to the sign convention for lenses, distances of real object, real image and real focus are positive. Do not trade positive for negative or zero.

q: According to the sign convention for lenses, distances of virtual object, virtual image and virtual focus are _____.
e: A real image can be put on a screen. A virtual image cannot; the rays only appear to meet. According to the sign convention for lenses, distances of virtual object, virtual image and virtual focus are negative. Do not trade negative for positive or zero.

q: According to the sign convention for lenses, the perpendicular distance measured _____ the principal axis is positive.
e: Lenses refract. Light is an electromagnetic wave and also a particle. According to the sign convention for lenses, the perpendicular distance measured above the principal axis is positive. Do not trade above for below or on.

q: According to the sign convention for lenses, the perpendicular distance measured below the principal axis is _____.
e: Lenses refract. Light is an electromagnetic wave and also a particle. According to the sign convention for lenses, the perpendicular distance measured below the principal axis is negative. Positive or zero is not this quantity.

q: The lens-makers' equation relates the focal length to the refractive index and the radii of _____.
e: Lenses refract. Light is an electromagnetic wave and also a particle. The lens-makers' equation relates the focal length to the refractive index and the radii of curvature. Thickness or diameter is not this quantity.
